subject: Renewal & Expansion - proposed volume step-ups, blended rates, and adding new model routes
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Andrew Park <andrew@novahealth.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps - renewal + expansion pricing

Andrew - thanks for the time earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our renewal/expansion discussion:

- Current: Nova Health is on the standard hosted plan consuming ~18M tokens/mo today (Q2 avg), with spikes up to ~30M for pilot campaigns.
- Expansion: You plan to add two new inference routes over the next 6 months (patient-summarization route + clinical-triage route) and test a higher-capacity model for one route. That could push steady-state to ~60-80M tokens/mo and up to ~150M in peak months.
- Ask from you: target unit economics of ~$850 / 1M tokens across blended usage, with clear step-ups as volume grows. Also need a simple way to add routes/models without an administrative pricing surprise.

Immediate next steps I promised:
1) Share a proposed tiered step-up pricing table and an example blended-rate calculation for your usage profile.
2) Outline how adding routes / model variants would be priced (flat add-on vs blended).
3) Provide a clean term-sheet PDF that procurement can start reviewing.

I attached your Q2 usage export you shared and the initial term-sheet draft. I'll work with David and Rafael to firm up numbers and send a proposal by EOD tomorrow. Anything I missed?

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: NovaHealth_usage_report_Q2.csv, redwood-pricing-term-sheet-v3.pdf

From: Andrew Park <andrew@novahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps - renewal + expansion pricing

Thanks Marissa - that's all correct. Two clarifications:

1) Budget: Procurement is targeting a renewal + expansion budget of roughly $65k- $90k/mo initially, with potential to expand after 90 days if SLA and latency look good.
2) Model mix: Most volume will stay on our cheaper base model (summarization), but roughly 20% of tokens will go to the higher-capacity route for triage. We want a blended target of ~$850 / 1M tokens as a negotiation target.

Procurement will want the term-sheet and a clear statement of how blended rates are calculated (we'll share a sample workbook). You can CC procurement@novahealth.com when you send the term-sheet.

-Andrew
Andrew Park
Head of Data Products, Nova Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Nova Health - budget + blended target ($850/1M) - need pricing options

David / Rafael - forwarding Andrew's note. Key constraints:
- New steady-state target: 60-80M tokens/mo; peaks to ~150M
- Budget target: $65k- $90k/mo initial, target blended unit economics ~$850 / 1M tokens
- Model mix: ~80% base model, ~20% higher-capacity route

Can we propose two options:
A) Step-up volume tiers with aggressive discounts at 50M+ and 100M+ tokens; show per-tier $/1M and example blended calc
B) Blended committed volume model: commit to X tokens/month at blended $/1M with flexibility to add routes at a small per-route fee or weight routes in blended calc

Also include language for adding a new model route mid-term (auto-blend vs additive surcharge). I think procurement will prefer simple blended pricing with clear math. Rafael - can you run the unit economics quickly and propose numbers that hit their $850 target while protecting margin?

- Marissa

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Nova Health - budget + blended target ($850/1M) - need pricing options

Marissa - ran a quick model. Two viable sails:

Option 1 - Tiered step-ups (recommended for flexibility):
- 0-10M: $1,100 / 1M
- 10-50M: $980 / 1M
- 50-150M: $760 / 1M
- 150M+: custom enterprise rate (negotiated)
Example blended calc for projected 80M (80M = 10M @1,100 + 40M @980 + 30M @760 => blended = $862 / 1M)

Option 2 - Committed blended (recommended for budget predictability):
- Commit 60M/mo for 12 months at $820 / 1M (monthly invoice = $49,200)
- Overages billed at $900 / 1M up to 150% of commit, then tiered negotiated rates beyond that
- Add new model route: first +1 route included per deal; additional routes +$40 / 1M applied to tokens routed to that model (to account for higher model-cost weight)

Notes: Option 1 gets you closer to no-commit flexibility; blended ends up around $862 on our estimate for 80M, which is near their $850 target. Option 2 hits their target at $820 if they commit 60M.

I attach a short calc sheet; David - if Legal/RevOps wants a conservative clause for blended math, we should include a sample weighted formula in the term-sheet.

- Rafael

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Andrew Park <andrew@novahealth.com>, procurement@novahealth.com
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposal: tiered step-ups + committed blended option - please review

Andrew / Procurement team - following up with two concrete options based on your notes. Attached is an updated term-sheet (redwood-pricing-term-sheet-v3.pdf) and a sample workbook with blended calculations. Summary below.

Option A - Tiered step-ups (flexible):
- 0-10M: $1,100 / 1M
- 10-50M: $980 / 1M
- 50-150M: $760 / 1M
- When multiple model routes are used, tokens are billed at the respective model-level tier. The blended customer rate is the usage-weighted average across tiers/routes.

Example (projected 80M, 80% base / 20% high-cap): blended = $862 / 1M (see attached workbook).

Option B - Committed Blended (budget-first, lower unit cost):
- Commit 60M/mo for 12 months at $820 / 1M => $49,200/mo
- Overages: $900 / 1M up to 150% of commit; 150%+ to be negotiated.
- Routes: first additional route included; adding further distinct model routes incurs +$40 / 1M on tokens routed to those models (applies to the blended calc).

Recommended pick: If Nova Health wants to lock to procurement budget and hit the $850 blended target, Option B at 60M commit gets them below target and keeps a clear monthly invoice. If they prefer flexibility, Option A will likely average near $860 at 80M and gives easier burst headroom.

Next steps:
1) Tell us preference (A or B) and desired commit size if B.
2) If procurement is comfortable, we'll generate a formal quote + SOW and route to Legal for a 12-month amendment to the renewal.
3) We can include a 60-day rollback right if performance/latency SLA is not met (standard for first 90 days).

Please respond with preference and I'll loop in RevOps/Legal.

Thanks - Marissa
